entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 family has four models, including a compact S27 Pro
entry.summary: Samsung will release the Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra.

entry.title: Shaky: Galaxy S27 Ultra may switch to Exynos 2700 because Snapdragon overheats
entry.summary: Samsung found the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 overheating in S27 Ultra testing and may use its own Exynos 2700 chip if Qualcomm doesn't fix it by mid-October.

entry.title: Confirmed: Apple Intelligence fully launches in China with iOS 27.3 in December
entry.summary: After an October beta, Apple will roll out Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3 in December, without the new Siri, Image Playground or the newer Genmoji.

entry.title: Rumor: NVIDIA swaps the RTX 5080 to 24GB in Q1 2027
entry.summary: NVIDIA will release an RTX 5080 with 24GB of GDDR7 in early 2027, gradually replacing the 16GB model.

entry.title: Shaky: Galaxy S27 and S27+ start with just 8GB of RAM
entry.summary: Because of soaring memory prices, Samsung will sell 8GB/256GB versions of the Galaxy S27 and S27+ alongside 12GB/512GB models, while the S27 Pro and Ultra start at 12GB.

entry.title: Likely: Honor 700 series launches in November with three models and a rear screen on the Pro
entry.summary: Honor will launch three Honor 700 models in China in November; the 700 Pro has a 6.57-inch 1.5K screen, a 200MP main camera, a 50MP periscope telephoto, a 1.72-inch built-in rear display and a battery of about 9,000mAh.

entry.title: Confirmed: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, the successor to Argon, within weeks
entry.summary: Google's next Gemini 4 checkpoint, Carbon, is in partner early access and will be released publicly soon.

entry.title: Rumor: iPhone 18e keeps a 60Hz screen but gets the A20 and possibly a 24MP selfie camera
entry.summary: The iPhone 18e will have a 6.12-inch 60Hz LTPS OLED screen, the 2nm A20 chip, a single 48MP rear camera and maybe a 24MP front camera.

entry.title: Rumor: Second-generation touchscreen MacBook Pros get M7 Pro/Max in 2027, and non-touch Pro models are dropped
entry.summary: Apple will ship second-generation OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros with M7 Pro and M7 Max chips next year and then stop selling the non-touch M5 Pro/Max models, keeping only an entry 14-inch MacBook Pro that moves to M7 and the new thinner design without touch.

entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 Pro uses the regular Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, not the Ultra's Extreme chip
entry.summary: In Europe, the Galaxy S27 and S27+ use the Exynos 2700, the S27 Pro uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 (SM8950), and only the S27 Ultra gets the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, all with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage.

entry.title: Rumor: Standard iPhone 18 gets a bigger battery and a higher price
entry.summary: The standard iPhone 18 will have a larger battery than the iPhone 17's 3,692 mAh, keep a 6.3-inch 120Hz OLED with Dynamic Island, use the 2nm A20 and dual 48MP cameras, and may cost more.

entry.title: Rumor: Ubisoft bids to buy Arkane Lyon from Xbox
entry.summary: Ubisoft and at least two other game companies have made offers to buy Arkane Lyon, the studio making Marvel's Blade, and Xbox has also considered a management buyout.

entry.title: Rumor: Honor is testing a 14,000-15,000mAh phone battery for a week of use
entry.summary: Honor has a 14,000-15,000mAh high-density phone battery in trial production, aimed at a phone that lasts about a week per charge without being unusually thick or heavy.

entry.title: Likely: Galaxy A58 keeps 45W charging and ships without a charger in China
entry.summary: The Galaxy A58 (SM-A5860) supports 45W wired charging, the same as the A57, and comes without a charger in the box in China.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy Z Fold9 and Z Fold9 Ultra keep their predecessors' rear cameras
entry.summary: Samsung's 2027 book-style foldables carry over their rear cameras: the Fold9 Ultra keeps a 200MP main, 50MP ultrawide and 3x telephoto, and the wide Fold9 keeps 50MP main and 50MP ultrawide cameras.

entry.title: Likely: Samsung readies Galaxy T1 ear-hook sports earbuds, including for the US
entry.summary: Samsung will launch ear-hook fitness earbuds, model SM-R545 and codenamed Galaxy T1, in several markets including the US.

entry.title: Likely: PS6 and the next Xbox slip because of the memory shortage
entry.summary: Sony's PS6 and Microsoft's next Xbox (Project Helix) will launch later than planned because of high memory prices.

entry.title: Rumor: OnePlus readies a Turbo Pro phone with an unreleased Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Pro
entry.summary: OnePlus is developing a Turbo Pro (possibly Turbo 7 Pro) with a new 3nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Pro (SM8845 Pro), a 6.78-inch 1.5K 185Hz screen, a 200MP main camera and a 9,000mAh battery, launching around the end of the year.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 Ultra gets thinner bezels and a thicker camera bump
entry.summary: The Galaxy S27 Ultra will have 1.28mm screen bezels (vs 1.32mm on the S26 Ultra) and a 4.69mm camera bump, slightly thicker than today's.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung's Android XR glasses go on sale in mid-December, in Korea and the US only
entry.summary: Samsung's display-free Intelligent Eyewear (Android XR, Gemini, Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1) goes on sale in mid-December in South Korea and the US first, with Europe, China and Japan later; pricing is not set.

entry.title: Rumor: Sony announces the PlayStation 6 in early March 2027
entry.summary: Sony's current roadmap targets a PlayStation 6 announcement in early March 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: OnePlus 16T is a compact phone with a Dimensity 9600M and two 200MP cameras
entry.summary: A compact Oppo-made phone will launch outside China as the OnePlus 16T with a 6.35-inch 1.5K 120Hz LTPO screen, MediaTek's 3nm Dimensity 9600M, a 200MP main camera and a 200MP periscope, a metal frame under 9mm and a battery of about 7,000mAh with 80W charging.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy A38 gets a 6,000mAh battery, the A30 series' first upgrade in six years
entry.summary: The Galaxy A38's battery is rated at 5,882mAh, likely marketed as 6,000mAh, up from the 5,000mAh the A30 line has used since the Galaxy A31; charging likely stays at 45W.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple weighs cheaper high-mobility oxide (HMO) backplanes for future Mac OLED screens
entry.summary: Apple is evaluating ways to mass-produce high-mobility oxide (HMO) TFT backplanes for future OLED panels, possibly as a successor to LTPO, with Samsung Display and LG Display favoring a cheaper sputtering process over atomic layer deposition.

entry.title: Rumor: Huawei Mate X8 foldable launches in November
entry.summary: Huawei will launch the Mate X8 in China in November with Kirin 9050/9050 Pro chips, an 8.15-inch inner and 6.5-inch cover screen, a 50MP 1/1.28-inch variable-aperture main camera, a 50MP periscope and a battery above 6,000mAh, plus a privacy-display version.

entry.title: Likely: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max cost EUR 1,449-1,849 in Europe with smaller batteries
entry.summary: The European Xiaomi 18 Pro will cost EUR 1,449 (256GB) or EUR 1,649 (512GB) with a 6,000mAh-rated battery and 90W charging, and the 18 Pro Max EUR 1,849 (512GB) with a 7,050mAh-rated battery and 100W, both smaller than the Chinese versions' 7,000mAh and 8,500mAh.

entry.title: Rumor: BYD's Yangwang Altior luxury sedan debuts in Dubai around Nov 5 with solid-state batteries
entry.summary: BYD will unveil its 5.5-meter Yangwang Altior executive sedan in Dubai around Nov 5, as the first car with BYD's solid-state batteries, priced around 2 million yuan.

entry.title: Rumor: Atlus is remaking the first Persona game
entry.summary: Leaked footage shows a remake of Revelations: Persona in development, built in Unreal Engine.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra get an upgraded Privacy Display; S27 and S27+ don't
entry.summary: Samsung will put an improved version of the S26 Ultra's Privacy Display, plus brighter screens, on both the Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra, while the S27 and S27+ go without.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple launches an OLED iPad Air, a vapor-chamber iPad Pro and an A19 base iPad in the first half of 2027
entry.summary: Apple will release three iPads in the first half of 2027: an iPad Air with an OLED screen, an iPad Pro with a new chip and vapor-chamber cooling, and a base iPad with the A19, 8GB of RAM (enabling Apple Intelligence), the N1 wireless chip and the C1X modem.
